description: This file implements an image proxy backend for Mattermost, handling image retrieval, content type detection, and security headers.

classes.name: LocalBackend
classes.description: Handles local image proxy requests, fetching images, and serving them with security headers.

classes.name: URLError
classes.description: Represents a malformed URL error during proxy request creation.

classes.name: contentTypeRecorder
classes.description: Wraps http.ResponseWriter to set Content-Disposition based on content type.

classes.name: proxyRequest
classes.description: Represents a proxied image request with URL and original request.

methods.name: makeLocalBackend()
methods.description: Creates a new LocalBackend instance with configured HTTP client and base URL.

methods.name: WriteHeader()
methods.description: Sets Content-Disposition header based on content type.

methods.name: GetImage()
methods.description: Fetches an image from a URL and writes it to the ResponseWriter with security headers.

methods.name: GetImageDirect()
methods.description: Retrieves an image directly as a ReadCloser, used for internal requests.

methods.name: ServeImage()
methods.description: Proxies an image request, fetches remote image, and writes it to the ResponseWriter with security headers.

methods.name: copyHeader()
methods.description: Copies specified headers from source to destination.

methods.name: should304()
methods.description: Determines if the response can be a 304 Not Modified based on headers.

methods.name: peekContentType()
methods.description: Peeks at the first 512 bytes of data to detect content type.

methods.name: contentTypeMatches()
methods.description: Checks if a content type matches allowed patterns.

methods.name: newProxyRequest()
methods.description: Creates a proxyRequest object from an HTTP request and base URL.

methods.name: parseURL()
methods.description: Parses a URL string, fixing common URL munging issues.
